articles.title: U.S. Treasury Department proposes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule
articles.snippet: The Treasury proposal would establish some of the core definitions and jurisdictions in the law Congress completed last year.

articles.title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade has 66 proposals, including a major privacy fix
articles.snippet: Developers are narrowing the list for the Hegotá upgrade, including a package to change how wallets approve and pay for transactions, giving developers of privacy apps more of the tools they need inside Ethereum itself.

articles.title: Bitcoin options remain expensive despite summer calm. Here's why it matters
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s implied volatility is near a seasonal floor, but options continue to price substantially more movement than the market is delivering.

articles.title: Binance handed user data to Russia that led to a Ukrainian donor's arrest
articles.snippet: Binance says it cooperates with lawful requests, despite exiting the Russian market in 2023 to improve its compliance strategy.

articles.title: The bitcoin futures market looks like a crowded club with a tiny exit – and it could cause pain
articles.snippet: The market may be facing a dangerous liquidity mismatch as futures open interest outpaces trading volume by a significant margin.
